title: Compact offline installer journey kit and annotated upgrade screenshots
creator: Marisol Vega
description: Create a compact visual asset kit and annotated screenshots for the Private/VPC offline installer and upgrade flow. Assets intended for: the quickstart docs, release notes, and in-console micro-help. Deliverables include a compact 6-step installer storyboard, network validation microcopy overlays, lightweight progress GIFs for slow networks, annotated upgrade rollback modal screenshots, and responsive variants (desktop/tablet/phone). Focus is on clarity for operators who use CLI-first installs and for product pages where space is constrained. Ensure assets are accessible (contrast, alt text), ready for the docs CDN, and packaged with Figma components and export presets.
acceptance_criteria: One compact 6-frame storyboard illustrating the offline installer journey, exported at 1200x675, 800x450, and 600x338
Network validation checklist overlay copy finalized and reviewed by Eng; copy includes explicit retry/error recovery language
Three annotated screenshots for the upgrade UI: pre-checks, upgrade-in-progress with progress bar, and rollback-confirmation state
Animated GIFs (looping) demonstrating file transfer + validation for slow networks (under 1MB each) optimized for docs
All assets added to Figma with component tokens and a matching export preset; links added to the Confluence PRD
Accessibility review completed: contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for text, and alt text strings provided for each asset
Design files and exported assets uploaded to docs CDN and referenced in docs ticket PM-4112
